questions.concept: India under East India Company’s Rule
questions.question: From which places did Lord Cornwallis start the permanent settlement system?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengal and Bihar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Permanent Settlement:-**

 
 
• **Lord Cornwallis started the Permanent Settlement system from Bengal, Bihar, and Orissa in 1793. **
 
• It was later extended to other parts of India, including Varanasi and the south district of Madras.
 
• **The Permanent Settlement system was a land revenue system that fixed the amount of land revenue that zamindars, or landlords, had to pay to the British East India Company. **
 
• This system was designed to provide a stable source of revenue for the company and to create a class of loyal landlords who would support British rule.
 
• However, the Permanent Settlement system had a number of negative consequences. **It led to a concentration of land ownership in the hands of a small number of zamindars, and it made it difficult for the government to collect taxes from peasants.**
 
• The system also discouraged investment in agriculture and led to widespread poverty.

questions.question: In the central budget 2023-24, the term 'Amrit Peedhi' refers to:

options.text: children as the future of India

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**youth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Union Budget 2023-24:-**

 
• It was presented by Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on February 1, 2023.
 
• The budget had a strong focus on empowering the youth, especially the Amrit Peedhi, through education, skill development, and job creation.
 
• In the central budget 2023-24, **the term 'Amrit Peedhi' refers to the generation that will be responsible for building India in the next 25 years. It is a Hindi term that literally means 'Nectar Generation'.**
 
• The term was first used by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in 2021 to refer to the generation of Indians who will be born after the country's 75th anniversary of independence in 2022.
 
• This generation will be tasked with carrying India forward into its next phase of development, which is known as the 'Amrit Kaal' (Nectar Age).
 
• Some of the key highlights of the Union Budget 2023-24:
 
 
• **Education:**
 
 
• Establishment of a National Digital University to provide high-quality education to students across India.
 
• Increase in the number of Eklavya Model Residential Schools for tribal students.
 
• Launch of a new scheme to provide scholarships to students from Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes for studying abroad.
 
 
 
• **Skill development:**
 
 
• Launch of Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 to skill lakhs of youth within the next three years.
 
• Setting up of 30 Skill India International Centres across different states to skill the youth for international opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Job creation:**
 
 
• Increase in the capital expenditure outlay by 33% to Rs 10 lakh crore, which will create jobs and boost economic growth.
 
• Launch of a new scheme to provide financial assistance to startups and MSMEs.
 
• Extension of the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme to new sectors, such as textiles and food processing.

questions.question: Which district of Madhya Pradesh is a leading producer of copper?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Balaghat**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Balaghat:-**

 
 
• **The Balaghat district of Madhya Pradesh is the leading producer of copper in the state. **
 
• It is home to the Malanjkhand Copper Project, which is the largest copper mine in India.
 
• The Malanjkhand mine accounts for nearly 70% of the country's copper reserves and contributes around 80% to Hindustan Copper Limited's (HCL) total copper production.
 
• In addition to the Malanjkhand mine, there are several other copper mines in the Balaghat district, including the Shitalpani, Gidhri Dhorli, Jatta, and Garhi Dongri mines.
 
• The Balaghat district accounts for over 40% of India's total copper production.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jabalpur district:-**

 
 
• It has several copper mines, including the Bagalkot, Rajarampahar, and Sonakhan mines.
 
• **These mines are operated by Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL). The Jabalpur district accounts for around 10% of Madhya Pradesh's total copper production.**
 
 
 
• **Bhopal district:-**
 
 
• It has a few copper mines, including the Baijnath and Narsinghgarh mines.
 
• These mines are also operated by HCL.
 
• **The Bhopal district accounts for around 5% of Madhya Pradesh's total copper production**
 
 
 
• **Gwalior district:-**
 
 
• It has a few copper mines, including the Khaniyadhana and Morar mines.
 
• These mines are operated by private companies.
 
• **The Gwalior district accounts for around 2% of Madhya Pradesh's total copper production.**

questions.question: India is a parliamentary democracy based on the Westminster model of _______.
questions.solution: The correct answer is __**the United Kingdom.**__ __** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** • **Westminster Model:-** • **It is a system of parliamentary government that originated in the United Kingdom.** • **India is a parliamentary democracy based on the Westminster model of government.** • It is characterized by the following features: • A head of state who is a constitutional monarch or president, with largely ceremonial powers. • A head of government, usually the prime minister, who is the leader of the political party or coalition with the majority of seats in the lower house of parliament. • A cabinet of ministers who are appointed by the prime minister and are responsible to parliament. • A bicameral parliament, consisting of a lower house and an upper house. • A strong tradition of parliamentary sovereignty, meaning that parliament is the supreme lawmaking body.

questions.concept: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
questions.question: In which group of the Periodic Table will you put the elements with electronic configuration [He]2s² 2p⁶?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**18**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Group 18:-**

 
 
• **The elements with electronic configuration [He]2s² 2p⁶ will be in group 18 of the Periodic Table. **
 
• This group is also known as the noble gases.
 
• **The group number of an element is determined by the number of valence electrons it has. **
 
• The valence electrons are the outermost electrons in an atom's shell.
 
• The elements in group 18 all have 8 valence electrons, which is a full outer shell.
 
• This full outer shell makes them very stable and unreactive.
 
• **The elements in group 18 are:**
 
 
• **Helium (He)**
 
• **Neon (Ne)**
 
• **Argon (Ar)**
 
• **Krypton (Kr)**
 
• **Xenon (Xe)**
 
• **Radon (Rn)**
 
 
 
• These elements are all colorless and odorless gases at room temperature.
 
• They are also very non-toxic.

questions.question: What level of prevention is targeted by water defluoridation?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Primary prevention.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Primary prevention:-**

 
 
• **Water defluoridation is a primary level of prevention. **
 
• Primary prevention is **aimed at preventing the occurrence of a disease or condition before it even begins.**
 
• In the case of water defluoridation, the goal is to prevent dental and skeletal fluorosis by removing excess fluoride from drinking water.
 
• Dental fluorosis is a condition that causes discoloration and pitting of the teeth.
 
• Skeletal fluorosis is a more serious condition that can cause bone pain, stiffness, and deformities.
 
• Both dental and skeletal fluorosis can be caused by consuming excessive amounts of fluoride, especially during childhood.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Tertiary prevention:-**

 
 
• It reduces the severity of a disease or condition and improve quality of life after it has already occurred.
 
 
 
• **Secondary prevention:-**
 
 
• It detects and treat a disease or condition early, before it causes serious harm.
 
 
 
• **Primordial prevention:-**
 
 
• It prevents the development of a disease or condition before it even begins.

questions.question: What is the name of the oceanic trench in the Indian Ocean with a maximum depth of 23,560 feet?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Java Trench**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Java Trench:-**

 
 
• **The oceanic trench in the Indian Ocean with a maximum depth of 23,560 feet is the Java Trench.**
 
• It is located south of the Indonesian island of Java, and is the deepest point in the Indian Ocean.
 
• **The Java Trench is a subduction zone, where the Indo-Australian Plate is sliding underneath the Eurasian Plate.**
 
• This process creates intense heat and pressure, which can lead to earthquakes and volcanic eruptions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tonga Trench:-**

 
 
• **It is the deepest oceanic trench in the Southern Hemisphere, with a maximum depth of 35,853 feet (10,932 meters). **
 
• It is located in the South Pacific Ocean, east of the Tonga archipelago.
 
• The Tonga Trench is a subduction zone, where the Pacific Plate is sliding underneath the Indo-Australian Plate.
 
 
 
• **Amirante Trench:-**
 
 
• **It is the deepest oceanic trench in the Indian Ocean, with a maximum depth of 21,959 feet (6,695 meters). **
 
• It is located in the western Indian Ocean, south of the Amirante Islands.
 
• The Amirante Trench is a transform fault, where two tectonic plates are sliding past each other. This process creates intense friction, which can lead to earthquakes.
 
 
 
• **Diamantina Trench:-**
 
 
• **It is a fracture zone in the Indian Ocean, extending westward from the southwest coast of Australia. **
 
• It is not a true oceanic trench, as it does not have the same depth or structure as other trenches such as the Tonga Trench or the Amirante Trench.

questions.question: Which of the following articles is related to the provision of Co-operative Societies in the Indian Constitution?

• Co-operative Societies:

 
 
• The 97th Constitutional Amendment Act of 2011 gave constitutional status and protection to cooperative societies.
 
• In this context, it made the following three changes in the constitution:
 
 
• It made the right to form cooperative societies a fundamental right (Article 191).
 
• It included a new Directive Principle of State Policy on the promotion of cooperative societies (Article 43-B2).
 
• It added a new Part IX-B in the Constitution which is entitled “The Cooperative Societies” (Articles 243-ZH to 243-ZT).

questions.question: Who was the Sultan of Delhi at the time of the establishment of Vijayanagara Empire?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohammad bin Tughlaq**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Muhammad bin Tughluq:-**

 
 
• **He was the second sultan of the Tughlaq dynasty.**
 
• He was a brilliant and ambitious ruler, but he was also controversial and his reforms were largely unsuccessful.
 
• Tughluq was a well-educated man with a wide range of interests, including medicine, astronomy, logic, and philosophy.
 
• He was also a skilled linguist, speaking Persian, Hindavi, Arabic, Sanskrit, and Turkish.
 
• **The Sultan of Delhi at the time of the establishment of the Vijayanagara Empire was Muhammad bin Tughluq.**
 
 

 
• ** Vijayanagara Empire:-**

 
 
• The establishment of the Vijayanagara Empire was one of the most significant events in the history of South India.
 
• **The empire reached its peak under Krishnadevaraya (1509-1529 CE), who was a powerful and benevolent ruler.**
 
• The Vijayanagara Empire played a major role in promoting trade and culture in South India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nasiruddin Mahmud:-**

 
 
• **He was the grandson of Iltutmish and the eighth sultan of the Mamluk dynasty. **
 
• He was a pious and scholarly ruler, but he was also weak and indecisive.
 
• As a result, he was unable to control his nobles, and the kingdom was plagued by rebellions and instability during his reign.
 
 
 
• **Iltutmish:-**
 
 
• **He was the third sultan of the Mamluk dynasty. **
 
• He was a powerful and capable ruler who consolidated the power of the dynasty and established a strong central administration.
 
• He also introduced the silver tanka as the currency of the Delhi Sultanate.

questions.question: Who introduced permanent settlement policy in 1793 to fix the revenue between East India Company and landlords?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Lord Cornwallis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Permanent settlement:

 
 
• Lord Cornwallis in 1793 introduced this policy.
 
• It was applied to Bengal, Bihar, Odisha, Banaras, etc. Total 19% of British India under it.
 
• The system wanted to create one ownership only.
 
• So, ownership was given to zamindars who will be loyal to the government.
 
• It was hereditary ownership.
 
• It became easy for the British to collect the revenue. 11/10 th part to the British; rest with the zamindars.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The first factory act (1881) was passed him which prohibited the working of children below seven years and a limited number of working hours for children below 12 years.
 
• He also increased the age requirement for civil services from 18 years to 21 years.
 
• He repealed Vernacular Press Act and allowed freedom of the press.
 
• He continued the policy of financial devolution inaugurated under Lord Mayo

• **He is responsible for the Subsidiary Alliance system, the introduction of a modern tax system and the establishment of a number of educational and cultural institutions.**

questions.question: When did Louis Pasteur discover molecular chirality and observe that crystals of some compounds exist as mirror images which laid the foundation for modern stereochemistry?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1848**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Louis Pasteur:-**

 
 
• **He was a French chemist and microbiologist who is considered one of the founders of modern medicine.**
 
• He made significant contributions to our understanding of fermentation, disease, and vaccination.
 
• **Louis Pasteur discovered molecular chirality and observed that crystals of some compounds exist as mirror images in 1848. **
 
• He was studying the crystals of sodium ammonium tartrate, a salt of tartaric acid.
 
• He noticed that the crystals could be separated into two groups, one of which was a mirror image of the other.
 
• Pasteur realized that this difference in shape was due to the different spatial arrangements of the atoms in the two molecules.
 
• **He called this phenomenon "dissymmetry." Today, we call it "chirality."**
